thread:
Avery: Quick sync — need a short decision for the RFC: how pins should express compatibility ranges, tie-breakers, TTL, observe-only canaries, and provenance sanitization.

Kai: I vote for explicit compat ranges + numeric priority. Deterministic routing is crucial. Example sketch inline.

Marta: +1. Also must include provenance + provenance_sanitized boolean, and safety_tags so Console can lock regulated pins.

Devon: Ops checklist: define tie-breaker (priority -> created_at), define behavior when no band matches, and ensure controllers reject unsupported schema_version.

Avery: Minimal sketch (human-readable) — put in RFC:```json { "pin_id": "acct-7/stable-1", "schema_version": "1", "mode": "soft|hard|sticky", "ttl_seconds": 86400, "observe_only": false, "compat_bands": [{"min_version": "1.2.0", "max_version": "1.4.9", "priority": 100}], "fallback_policy": "tenant_default|route_variant|fail_fast", "origin": "rollout-service", "provenance_sanitized": true, "confidence": 0.9, "safety_tags": ["no-cache"], "deprecated_by": null }``` Keep schema_version to allow safe evolution.

Kai: nit: use strings for versions to avoid parse issues. For multiple matching bands: pick highest priority; on tie pick earliest created_at; document precisely.

Marta: Security: provenance may leak secrets. Server-side sanitizer must redact keys that match /(KMS|HSM|SECRET|TOKEN)/i and set provenance_sanitized=true. Also add optional allowed_routes list to restrict routing surface for sensitive pins.

Devon: What about GC and deprecation workflow? Suggest deprecated_by points to successor pin_id; controllers should surface suggestions but require manual confirmation for auto-roll-forward. Add deprecation_ts and keep TTL semantics clear (ttl 0 => infinite).

release-bot: notice: dry-run rollout queued for acct-7 at 3790123470.

Avery: Action items: 1) I'll draft RFC with schema, tie-breaker pseudocode, sanitization rules and examples; 2) Kai add allow_unstable flag suggestion; 3) Devon create Console ticket to surface pin filters and alerts for observe_only; 4) Marta review sanitizer rules. Target RFC draft by EOD Wed.

Kai: :thumbsup: happy with this direction.

Marta: :eyes: will watch for any hidden secret leakage.

Avery: Thanks—closing the sync. We'll reconvene after RFC comments. :coffee:
